full_source_population: 4424 raw records; 3630 labeled Dropout/Graduate, of which 2541 train, 544 validation, 545 locked test
audit_explanations: all 544 validation rows, not a sample of 20
descriptive: all 3085 development rows with separate train and validation groups; never inspect test outcomes
stability: 10 seeds, 10 backgrounds, up to 10 eligible small continuous-grade perturbations per validation row
faithfulness: top-five grouped SHAP ranked deletion vs 50 random group orders per row
pair_analysis: ten reference-masking pair effects per validation row
surrogates: OLS, Ridge, Lasso, main-only and paired, per validation row
recourse: all flagged validation students; debtor and tuition status single/combined changes only
historical_grade_simulation: retrospective sensitivity, not feasible post-first-semester intervention
final_test: never load or rerun existing final test; preserve final_test.lock
approval: exploratory subsequent validation work, independent reviewer approval pending
